messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — prepping a QBR for VeloxHealth next Thu. Finance flagged unusual burn; want to align on token runway + budget-trigger playbook.

Ajay Patel: Can you paste month-over-month token split (embeddings vs gen)?

Maria Chen: Rough: total 12.6M tokens — embeddings ~7.8M (62%), gen ~4.8M (38%). Spike tied to a new nightly re-index.

Jordan Lee: Per-route spend shows embeddings 40% of calls but 70% of payload bytes. Looks like daily bulk re-index at 02:00 UTC.

Kenji Sato: Suggest incremental indexing + prefix KV caching on our side — should cut token churn ~25%.

Elena Ortiz: I have enablement Wed 10am PT. Need a 1-slide cost explainer + one-pager on throttles/alerts.

Maria Chen: I'll draft the one-pager. Key recs: incremental index, batching window + KV cache, set budget alerts at 75%/90% of committed run rate.

Ajay Patel: Forecast: if pattern holds next 30d ≈ $6.2k (embeddings $4.1k, gen $2.1k). With 25% embedding reduction ≈ $4.9k.

Kenji Sato: Command I used: ```redwood forecast --account veloxhealth --window 30 --detailed``` Attach to QBR packet.

Maria Chen: Can someone create automated budget alerts to ping account team + velox billing at 75% and 90%? Test before Wed.

BillingBot: @Maria Chen — budget alerts created for veloxhealth at 75% and 90%. Test alert available via simulator. :robot_face:

Jordan Lee: Running spike simulator (+200k embedding tokens) to verify alert routing.

Jordan Lee: Update: 75% test alerted #velox-ops and billing@veloxhealth.com. 90% not fired. Screenshots uploaded to QBR folder. :white_check_mark:

Elena Ortiz: I'll include alert flow in deck and add opt-in script for "cost-saver" mode (lower throughput, aggressive caching) during maintenance.

Maria Chen: Action items: Kenji — incremental-index config (EOD). Ajay — 30d forecast + delta. Jordan — screenshots + receipts. Elena — final slide + invite. I'll run billing walkthrough Wed.

Kenji Sato: Example config preview: ```indexing: mode: incremental batch_size: 500 window: 30m enable_prefix_cache: true```

Ajay Patel: Uploading forecast CSV and assumptions to QBR folder.

Maria Chen: Also capture Velox feedback on embedding fidelity after their quantization change last quarter — could explain re-index. Elena, add feedback checkbox to agenda?

Elena Ortiz: Added poll: "Did you notice lower embedding recall since quantization?"

Maria Chen: Great. I'll circulate final packet Tue COB. :v:
